root.label: Israeli settler attack on Qusra Palestinians

events.label: Israeli settler attack on Qusra Palestinians

slots.name: attack method
slots.sentence: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians in the occupied West Bank on Saturday, pelting them with rocks and trapping residents in their homes.

slots.name: reports of IDF misconduct
slots.sentence: Other Palestinians said IDF officers had handcuffed, blindfolded and beaten residents trapped inside before letting them go.

slots.name: number of injuries
slots.sentence: A number of Palestinians said they were injured after being pepper sprayed by settlers, and reported that other Israeli settlers had tried to burn nearby fields owned by Palestinians.

slots.name: number of residents targeted
slots.sentence: When dozens of residents sought to barricade themselves in a home, settlers followed them in, according to the Israel Defense Forces (IDF).
